name: Journey to the Marsh
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Now it is time for you to earn your mage's wand.  To begin this quest, speak with the human hermit Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.  You will find her shack deep in the marsh, west of Theramore.

Speak with her, for her knowledge is vast.  You will find Tabetha's cottage west of Theramore, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Quiet! I'm in a delicate juncture and mustn't be disturbed!

One moment...

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 30 to 40, 9,890 XP in all.

quests.name: Hidden Secrets
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Magus Tirth in the Shimmering Flats.

quests.name: Get the Scoop
quests.objectiveText: Find the phrase to Tirth's strongbox, then return to Tirth.

quests.name: Rituals of Power
quests.objectiveText: Bring the book Rituals of Power to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Mage's Wand
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Tabetha after her ritual.
